claim: The snippet shows that one day after 2024-02-28 is 2024-02-29, and that February 2025 has 28 days.

bundle.snippet:
from datetime import date, timedelta

print(date(2024, 2, 28) + timedelta(days=1))
print((date(2025, 3, 1) - date(2025, 2, 1)).days)
bundle.run_log:
